text:
Maya Singh: Quick internal launch note: Performance Insights for Hosted API is GA today (rolled at 07:00 PT). This adds model-level p50/p95 latency breakdowns, token efficiency metrics, and request-path heatmaps in Console -> Insights. Please skim if you own SDKs, observability, or customer comms.

Ethan Brooks: Nice! Any behavior changes or new endpoints?

Maya Singh: No API changes for customers. We emit new internal telemetry tags (route, model_variant, batch_size_bucket). These are internal only and will help Surface recommendations in Optimize.

Maya Singh: Example of what you'll see in the dashboard: top slow routes, model heatmap by seq_len, and token-cost delta after quantization.

OpsBot: metrics: new-insight-metrics registered (2003000100) :chart_with_upwards_trend:

DevEx Bot: SDK note: we added a lightweight helper in redwood-js@1.0.2 to attach trace-ids for correlating logs with Insights. See repo examples.

Lydia Tran: Any billing or SLA changes?

Maya Singh: No billing changes. SLA unchanged. Insights are observability only. We may later offer premium retention as an add-on.

QA Bot: Rollout status: canary 5% -> 25% succeeded (2003000150)

Maya Singh: Rollback triggers: if ingestion lag > 2m sustained or metric spikes cause significant dashboard errors. Ops can toggle insights-ingest feature-flag to disable. Page: insight-ingest-failure.

Ethan Brooks: Can SREs access the raw traces?

Maya Singh: Yes, RBAC scoped in Console. Only teams with Observability role can view full traces; aggregated charts are wider.

Maya Singh: Action items: Observability owners, verify dashboards; SDK owners, pull the helper and test trace attachment; Support, expect a short FAQ in #announcements-support later today. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup:
